blocks.text: **up** — eng ko'p ma'noli kichik so'z, shuning uchun unga uch dars ajratilgan. 142-darsda **up** — «yuqoriga, ko'proq» (turn up, put up prices); 144-darsda — «butunlay, oxirigacha» (use up, tidy up). Bu darsda — kundalik hayot va biografiyada eng ko'p ishlatiladigan up fe'llari: **yaqinlashish** (walk up to), **boshlash va yaratish** (set up, take up), **ulg'ayish va tarbiya** (grow up, bring up), **kutilmagan natija** (end up, turn up) va serma'no «ishchi fe'llar»: give up, make up, look up. Asoslari: → qizil kitob, 121-dars.

rows: go up to, come up to, walk up to, run up to
come up, turn up, show up
set up, take up, start up, open up

blocks.text: Yaqinlashish va paydo bo'lish: walk up to, come up

**go / come / walk / run up to** + kishi yoki joy — kimningdir **yoniga bormoq / kelmoq**: A stranger **came up to** me. O'zbekchada bu «yaqinlashmoq», «yoniga kelmoq». **come up** esa to'ldiruvchisiz uch ma'noda ishlatiladi: (masala, ism, mavzu) **tilga olinmoq, chiqib qolmoq** — Your name **came up**; (quyosh) **chiqmoq**; (voqea) **yaqinlashib qolmoq** — My exams are **coming up**.

items.text: An old woman **came up to** Kate and asked her to read a letter.
items.translation: Bir keksa ayol Keytning **yoniga kelib**, xat o'qib berishini so'radi.

items.text: A problem has **come up** with the booking, so I need to call the hotel.
items.translation: Bron bilan bog'liq muammo **chiqib qoldi**, mehmonxonaga qo'ng'iroq qilishim kerak.

blocks.text: Boshlash va yaratish: set up, take up

**set up** — yangi narsani **tashkil qilmoq** (a company, a fund, a meeting) yoki jihozni **o'rnatib sozlamoq** (a computer, a projector). **take up** — sport, xobbi yoki cholg'u bilan **shug'ullana boshlamoq**: take up yoga — yogaga qo'l urmoq. **take up** ning yana ikki ma'nosi bor: joy yoki vaqtni **egallamoq** (The bed **takes up** half the room) va taklifni **qabul qilmoq** (take up an offer). Bu ma'nolarda o'zbekchaga «olmoq / egallamoq» to'g'ri keladi.

items.text: Bekzod **set up** an online English school during the pandemic.
items.translation: Bekzod pandemiya paytida onlayn ingliz tili maktabini **tashkil qildi**.

items.text: My mother **took up** yoga last year, and her back pain has gone.
items.translation: Onam o'tgan yili yogaga **qo'l urdi**, beli og'rig'i yo'qoldi.

blocks.text: O'zbekcha «katta bo'lmoq» va «katta qilmoq» inglizchada ikki xil fe'l. **grow up** — o'zi o'smoq (to'ldiruvchisiz): I **grew up** in Khiva. **bring up** — kimnidir tarbiyalab voyaga yetkazmoq (to'ldiruvchili): My aunt **brought** me **up**. Majhulda: I **was brought up** by my aunt («I was grown up» — xato). **bring up** ning ikkinchi ma'nosi — mavzuni **ko'tarmoq**, gap ochmoq: Don't **bring up** politics at dinner.
end up, turn up: kutilmagan natija

**end up** — rejalashtirilmagan, ko'pincha kutilmagan **yakuniy holat**. Undan keyin joy (end up **in** hospital), `-ing` (end up **paying** twice), **as** + kasb (end up **as** a teacher) yoki sifat (end up **exhausted**) keladi. O'zbekchada: «oxiri ... bo'lib qoldi», «borib-borib ...», «-ib qolmoq». **turn up** / **show up** — (kech yoki kutilmaganda) kelmoq, paydo bo'lmoq; **turn up** — yo'qolgan narsa topilib qolmoq ham.

items.text: We planned a quiet evening but **ended up** dancing until two in the morning.
items.translation: Tinch oqshom rejalashtirgan edik, lekin **oxiri** tungi soat ikkigacha **raqsga tushib qoldik**.

items.text: The plumber promised to come at nine but didn't **show up** until noon.
items.translation: Santexnik soat to'qqizda kelishga va'da berdi, lekin tushgacha **kelmadi**.

items.text: If you never check your bank account, you'll **end up** with no money.
items.translation: Bank hisobingni hech qachon tekshirmasang, **oxiri** pulsiz **qolasan**.

blocks.text: give up, make up, look up: ko'p ma'noli fe'llar
Uch qismli fe'llar: come up with, live up to

up bilan uch qismli fe'llar ko'p va ular so'zlashuvda juda tabiiy: **come up with** (o'ylab topmoq), **put up with** (chidamoq), **live up to** (kutilganni oqlamoq), **face up to** (haqiqatni tan olmoq), **own up to** (aybini bo'yniga olmoq), **stand up for** (himoya qilmoq), **stand up to** (qarshi tura olmoq). To'ldiruvchi — olmosh ham — doim oxirida: I can't **put up with** it (→ 137-dars). Predlogdan keyin fe'l kelsa — `-ing`: She **owned up to** breaking the vase (→ 60-dars).

items.text: The film didn't **live up to** all the excitement around it.
You should **stand up for** yourself when people treat you unfairly.
items.translation: Odamlar sizga adolatsiz munosabatda bo'lsa, **o'zingizni himoya qilishingiz** kerak.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I was grown up by my grandmother» → I **was brought up** by my grandmother; «I grew up my children alone» → I **brought up** my children alone; «give up to smoke» → **give up smoking**; «end up to pay» → **end up paying**; «take up a decision» → **make** a decision / **make up** your **mind**; kutilgan joyga kelmaganlikni ta'kidlash uchun — He didn't **turn up** / **show up** (oddiy «didn't come» dan aniqroq); «I respect to my father» → I **look up to** my father / I respect my father.

Biografiya «zinapoyasi» bilan yodlang: **grow up** (o'sdim) → **be brought up** by (tarbiyalandim) → **take up** (boshladim) → **give up** (tashladim) → **set up** (tashkil qildim) → **end up** (oxiri ... bo'ldim). O'zingiz haqida shu fe'llar bilan olti gapli qisqa hikoya yozing.
Bog'lanish: up — yuqoriga, ko'proq — 142-dars; up — butunlay (use up, tidy up, keep up with) — 144-dars; predlogdan keyin `-ing` — 60-dars; frazali fe'l turlari va olmosh o'rni — 137-dars.

items: **walk up to** / **come up to** — yoniga kelmoq; **come up** — chiqib qolmoq, tilga olinmoq, yaqinlashib qolmoq.
**set up** — tashkil qilmoq; **take up** — boshlamoq, joy / vaqt egallamoq, taklifni qabul qilmoq.
**grow up** — o'zi o'smoq; **bring up** — tarbiyalamoq (majhul: be brought up) yoki mavzuni ko'tarmoq.
**end up** + joy / `-ing` / as — oxiri ... bo'lib qolmoq; **turn up** / **show up** — kelmoq, topilib qolmoq.
**give up**, **make up**, **look up** — ko'p ma'noli; uch qismlilarda (put up with, live up to) olmosh oxirida turadi.

examples.title: Approaching and arising: **walk up to**, **come up**
examples.description: **go / come / walk / run up to** + kishi yoki joy — yoniga bormoq / kelmoq; **come up** — (masala, mavzu) chiqib qolmoq, tilga olinmoq; (quyosh) chiqmoq; (voqea) yaqinlashib qolmoq.

sentences.text: A young man **walked up to** me in the street and asked the way to the Registan.
sentences.translation: Ko'chada bir yigit **yonimga kelib**, Registonga qanday borishni so'radi.

sentences.text: Don't be shy — **go up to** her and introduce yourself!
sentences.translation: Uyalma — **yoniga borib**, o'zingni tanishtir!

sentences.text: As soon as the doors opened, the children **ran up to** their grandparents.
sentences.translation: Eshiklar ochilishi bilan bolalar bobo-buvilarining **oldiga yugurib borishdi**.

sentences.text: A waiter **came up to** our table and asked if everything was all right.
sentences.translation: Ofitsiant stolimiz **yoniga kelib**, hammasi joyidami, deb so'radi.

sentences.text: Your name **came up** several times during the meeting — in a good way!
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish davomida ismingiz bir necha marta **tilga olindi** — yaxshi ma'noda!

sentences.text: Sorry, something urgent has **come up** at the office, so I'll be late.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, ofisda shoshilinch ish **chiqib qoldi**, shuning uchun kechikaman.

sentences.text: We watched the sun **come up** over the mountains near Chimgan.
sentences.translation: Chimyon yaqinidagi tog'lar ortidan quyosh **chiqishini** tomosha qildik.

sentences.text: Jasur's birthday is **coming up**, so let's think about a present.
sentences.translation: Jasurning tug'ilgan kuni **yaqinlashib qoldi**, sovg'a haqida o'ylaylik.

sentences.text: If the question of money **comes up**, tell them we'll discuss it later.
sentences.translation: Agar pul masalasi **ko'tarilsa**, buni keyinroq muhokama qilamiz, deb ayting.

sentences.text: When Sarah **went up to** the stage to collect her prize, everyone stood and clapped.
sentences.translation: Sara mukofotini olish uchun sahnaga **chiqqanida**, hamma o'rnidan turib qarsak chaldi.

examples.title: Starting something: **set up**, **take up**, **start up**
examples.description: **set up** — (kompaniya, jamg'arma, uchrashuv) tashkil qilmoq; (jihozni) o'rnatmoq; **take up** — (sport, xobbi, cholg'u) bilan shug'ullana boshlamoq; **start up** — (biznes) ochmoq; (dvigatel) o't olmoq; **open up** — ochilmoq.

sentences.text: Two friends from Bukhara **set up** a small travel company five years ago.
sentences.translation: Buxorolik ikki do'st besh yil oldin kichik sayyohlik kompaniyasi **tashkil qilishdi**.

sentences.text: Could you help me **set up** the projector before the meeting starts?
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish boshlanishidan oldin proyektorni **o'rnatishga** yordam bera olasizmi?

sentences.text: The school has **set up** a special fund to help poorer students.
sentences.translation: Maktab kam ta'minlangan talabalarga yordam berish uchun maxsus jamg'arma **tashkil qildi**.

sentences.text: After he retired, Grandpa **took up** painting and now sells his pictures.
sentences.translation: Nafaqaga chiqqach, bobom rassomlikka **qo'l urdi** va hozir rasmlarini sotadi.

sentences.text: Kate **took up** the guitar at forty, and now she plays in a band.
sentences.translation: Keyt qirq yoshida gitara chalishni **boshladi**, hozir esa guruhda chaladi.

sentences.text: Have you ever thought about **taking up** a sport, like tennis or swimming?
sentences.translation: Hech tennis yoki suzish kabi biror sport turi bilan **shug'ullana boshlashni** o'ylab ko'rganmisiz?

sentences.text: Oliver borrowed money from his parents to **start up** his own café.
sentences.translation: Oliver o'z kafesini **ochish** uchun ota-onasidan qarz oldi.

sentences.text: It was so cold that the engine wouldn't **start up** this morning.
sentences.translation: Shunchalik sovuq ediki, bugun ertalab dvigatel **o't olmadi**.

sentences.text: My assistant will **set up** a meeting with the client for next Thursday.
sentences.translation: Yordamchim mijoz bilan kelasi payshanbaga uchrashuv **belgilaydi**.

sentences.text: A new Uzbek restaurant has **opened up** near our office, and it's always full.
sentences.translation: Ofisimiz yaqinida yangi o'zbek restorani **ochildi**, u doim odamga to'la.

examples.title: Growing and raising: **grow up**, **bring up**
examples.description: **grow up** — o'smoq, katta bo'lmoq (to'ldiruvchisiz); **bring up** — tarbiyalamoq, voyaga yetkazmoq (to'ldiruvchili; majhul: be brought up); **bring up** — (mavzuni) ko'tarmoq, gap ochmoq; **Grow up!** — kattalardek o'zingni tut!

sentences.text: Dilnoza **grew up** in Khiva, surrounded by ancient walls and old stories.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza qadimiy devorlar va rivoyatlar qurshovida, Xivada **o'sib-ulg'aygan**.

sentences.text: What did you want to be when you **grew up**? — A pilot, of course!
sentences.translation: Bolaligingda **katta bo'lsang** kim bo'lishni xohlarding? — Albatta, uchuvchi!

sentences.text: Bekzod was **brought up** by his grandparents after his parents moved to Russia.
sentences.translation: Ota-onasi Rossiyaga ko'chib ketgach, Bekzodni bobosi va buvisi **tarbiyalagan**.

sentences.text: **Bringing up** three children on one salary isn't easy.
sentences.translation: Bitta maosh bilan uchta bolani **voyaga yetkazish** oson emas.

sentences.text: We were **brought up** to respect older people and to help our neighbours.
sentences.translation: Bizni kattalarni hurmat qilish va qo'shnilarga yordam berish ruhida **tarbiyalashgan**.

sentences.text: Stop behaving like a child and **grow up**!
sentences.translation: Boladek o'zingni tutishni bas qil, **katta bo'l** endi!

sentences.text: I didn't want to **bring up** the subject of money at dinner.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqatda pul mavzusida **gap ochishni** xohlamadim.

sentences.text: At the meeting, Emma **brought up** the problem of the broken heating.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilishda Emma buzilgan isitish muammosini **ko'tardi**.

sentences.text: Children who **grow up** with pets are often more responsible.
sentences.translation: Uy hayvonlari bilan **o'sgan** bolalar ko'pincha mas'uliyatliroq bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Tom's parents **brought** him **up** to be honest, even when it's difficult.
sentences.translation: Tomning ota-onasi uni qiyin bo'lsa ham rostgo'y bo'lishga **o'rgatib katta qilishgan**.

examples.title: Unplanned results: **end up**, **turn up**, **show up**
examples.description: **end up** (+ joy / `-ing` / as / sifat) — oxir-oqibat ... bo'lib qolmoq; **turn up** / **show up** — (kech yoki kutilmaganda) kelmoq; **turn up** — yo'qolgan narsa topilib qolmoq.

sentences.text: We got lost and **ended up** in a tiny village fifty kilometres from Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Adashib, oxiri Buxorodan ellik kilometr naridagi kichkina qishloqqa **borib qoldik**.

sentences.text: If you don't save any money, you'll **end up** working until you're eighty.
sentences.translation: Pul jamg'armasang, **oxiri** sakson yoshgacha **ishlab yurasan**.

sentences.text: Jasur studied engineering but **ended up** as a chef in a London restaurant.
sentences.translation: Jasur muhandislikni o'qigan, lekin oxiri London restoranida **oshpaz bo'lib qoldi**.

sentences.text: I only went in for a coffee, but I **ended up** staying for three hours.
sentences.translation: Shunchaki qahva ichgani kirgandim, lekin **oxiri** u yerda uch soat **qolib ketdim**.

sentences.text: Be careful on that ladder, or you'll **end up** in hospital.
sentences.translation: Narvonda ehtiyot bo'l, bo'lmasa kasalxonaga **tushib qolasan**.

sentences.text: Half the guests **turned up** late because of the snow.
sentences.translation: Qor tufayli mehmonlarning yarmi kechikib **keldi**.

sentences.text: Don't worry about your ring — I'm sure it will **turn up** somewhere.
sentences.translation: Uzuging haqida xavotir olma — ishonamanki, u qayerdandir **topilib qoladi**.

sentences.text: Kate didn't **show up** for work yesterday, and nobody could reach her.
sentences.translation: Keyt kecha ishga **kelmadi**, hech kim u bilan bog'lana olmadi.

sentences.text: Guess who **showed up** at my door at midnight? My old university friend!
sentences.translation: Yarim tunda eshigim oldida kim **paydo bo'ldi**, top-chi? Universitetdagi eski do'stim!

sentences.text: My lost keys **turned up** in the pocket of my winter coat.
sentences.translation: Yo'qolgan kalitlarim qishki paltomning cho'ntagidan **chiqib qoldi**.

examples.title: **give up** and **make up**: several meanings
examples.description: **give up** (+ `-ing`) — tashlamoq; urinishni to'xtatmoq; **give up on** sb — umidini uzmoq; **give yourself up** — taslim bo'lmoq; **make up** — to'qib chiqarmoq; yarashmoq; tashkil qilmoq; **make up for** — o'rnini to'ldirmoq; **make up your mind** — qaror qilmoq.

sentences.text: Aziz **gave up** meat two years ago and feels much healthier.
sentences.translation: Aziz ikki yil oldin go'shtni **tashladi** va o'zini ancha sog'lom his qilyapti.

sentences.text: I tried to fix the printer myself, but after an hour I **gave up**.
sentences.translation: Printerni o'zim tuzatishga urindim, lekin bir soatdan keyin **qo'l siltadim**.

sentences.text: Her teachers had **given up on** her, but she passed all her exams.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchilari undan **umidini uzgan edi**, lekin u barcha imtihonlardan o'tdi.

sentences.text: The suspect **gave himself up** to the police after three days.
sentences.translation: Gumonlanuvchi uch kundan keyin politsiyaga **taslim bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: Nobody believed Tom's excuse — it was obvious he'd **made** it **up**.
sentences.translation: Tomning bahonasiga hech kim ishonmadi — uni **to'qib chiqargani** aniq edi.

sentences.text: The sisters didn't speak for a month, but they **made up** at their mother's birthday.
sentences.translation: Opa-singillar bir oy gaplashishmadi, lekin onalarining tug'ilgan kunida **yarashib olishdi**.

sentences.text: Young people **make up** almost half of Uzbekistan's population.
sentences.translation: O'zbekiston aholisining deyarli yarmini yoshlar **tashkil qiladi**.

sentences.text: I missed your birthday, so let me **make up for** it with dinner tonight.
sentences.translation: Tug'ilgan kuningni o'tkazib yubordim, kel, bugungi kechki ovqat bilan buning **o'rnini to'ldiray**.

sentences.text: Have you **made up** your mind yet — London or Edinburgh?
sentences.translation: **Qaror qildingmi** — Londonmi yoki Edinburg?

sentences.text: Don't **give up** your job until you've found a new one.
sentences.translation: Yangisini topmaguncha ishingni **tashlama**.

examples.title: **take up** and **look up**: several meanings
examples.description: **take up** — (joy, vaqt) egallamoq; (taklifni) qabul qilmoq; **look up** — (internetdan, lug'atdan) qarab topmoq; (ishlar) o'nglanmoq; **look** sb **up** — borib yo'qlamoq; **look up to** — hurmat qilmoq, o'rnak olmoq.

sentences.text: This old sofa **takes up** half the living room — let's sell it.
sentences.translation: Bu eski divan mehmonxonaning yarmini **egallaydi** — keling, sotaylik.

sentences.text: Paperwork **takes up** too much of a nurse's time.
sentences.translation: Qog'ozbozlik hamshiraning vaqtini juda ko'p **oladi**.

sentences.text: Madina decided to **take up** the offer of a job in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Madina Toshkentdagi ish taklifini **qabul qilishga** qaror qildi.

sentences.text: I'm sorry to **take up** so much of your time, but this is really important.
sentences.translation: Vaqtingizni bunchalik ko'p **olganim** uchun uzr, lekin bu juda muhim.

sentences.text: Before the interview, Bekzod **looked up** the company's history online.
sentences.translation: Suhbatdan oldin Bekzod kompaniya tarixini internetdan **o'rganib chiqdi**.

sentences.text: Things are finally **looking up** for Emma: she's got a new job and a nice flat.
sentences.translation: Nihoyat Emmaning ishlari **o'nglanyapti**: yangi ish va yaxshi kvartira topdi.

sentences.text: If you're ever in Edinburgh, **look** me **up** — I'd love to show you around.
sentences.translation: Edinburgga yo'lingiz tushsa, meni **yo'qlang** — sizga shaharni ko'rsatishni juda xohlardim.

sentences.text: Many young players **look up to** him because he never gives up.
sentences.translation: Ko'plab yosh futbolchilar uni **o'zlariga o'rnak qilib olishadi**, chunki u hech qachon taslim bo'lmaydi.

sentences.text: My grandmother is the person I **look up to** most.
sentences.translation: Men eng ko'p **hurmat qiladigan** inson — buvim.

sentences.text: The new desk is great, but it **takes up** too much space in such a small room.
sentences.translation: Yangi stol zo'r, lekin bunday kichkina xonada juda ko'p joy **egallaydi**.

examples.title: Three-part verbs: **come up with**, **live up to**
examples.description: **come up with** — o'ylab topmoq; **put up with** — chidamoq; **live up to** — (kutilganni) oqlamoq; **face up to** — (haqiqatni) tan olmoq; **own up to** — aybini bo'yniga olmoq; **stand up for** — himoya qilmoq; **stand up to** — qarshi tura olmoq.

sentences.text: We need to **come up with** a better name for the app before the launch.
sentences.translation: Ishga tushirishdan oldin ilova uchun yaxshiroq nom **o'ylab topishimiz** kerak.

sentences.text: How do you **put up with** such a long commute every day?
sentences.translation: Har kuni bunday uzoq yo'lga qanday **chidaysiz**?

sentences.text: The hotel didn't **live up to** the photos on its website.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona saytidagi suratlar uyg'otgan **umidlarni oqlamadi**.

sentences.text: Jasur felt he could never **live up to** his father's expectations.
sentences.translation: Jasur hech qachon otasining umidlarini **oqlay olmasligini** his qilardi.

sentences.text: Sooner or later you'll have to **face up to** the fact that you need help.
sentences.translation: Ertami-kechmi yordamga muhtojligingizni **tan olishingizga** to'g'ri keladi.

sentences.text: Nobody **owned up to** breaking the window, so the whole class was punished.
sentences.translation: Derazani sindirganini hech kim **bo'yniga olmadi**, shuning uchun butun sinf jazolandi.

sentences.text: Madina always **stands up for** her younger brother when the other kids tease him.
sentences.translation: Boshqa bolalar masxara qilganda Madina doim ukasini **himoya qiladi**.

sentences.text: It takes courage to **stand up to** a boss who shouts at people.
sentences.translation: Odamlarga baqiradigan boshliqqa **qarshi turish** uchun jasorat kerak.

sentences.text: In the end, Oliver **came up with** a solution that everybody liked.
sentences.translation: Oxiri Oliver hammaga ma'qul keladigan yechim **o'ylab topdi**.

sentences.text: I can't **put up with** his rudeness any longer — I'm going to complain.
sentences.translation: Uning qo'polligiga endi **chiday olmayman** — shikoyat qilaman.

examples.title: Mixed: from Khiva to London
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: bitta hayot hikoyasida up bilan fe'llar — grow up, bring up, take up, give up, end up, come up with, set up, make up, turn up, look up to.

sentences.text: Nilufar **grew up** in a small house near the old city walls of Khiva.
sentences.translation: Nilufar Xivaning qadimiy shahar devorlari yaqinidagi kichik uyda **o'sib-ulg'aydi**.

sentences.text: Her grandmother, who **brought** her **up**, taught her to sew and embroider.
sentences.translation: Uni **tarbiyalagan** buvisi unga tikish va kashta tikishni o'rgatdi.

sentences.text: At fifteen she **took up** English and studied every evening by the window.
sentences.translation: O'n besh yoshida u ingliz tiliga **qo'l urdi** va har oqshom deraza yonida o'qidi.

sentences.text: She nearly **gave up** when she failed her first IELTS exam.
sentences.translation: Birinchi IELTS imtihonidan yiqilganda u **voz kechishiga** sal qoldi.

sentences.text: But she tried again, won a scholarship and **ended up** at a university in London.
sentences.translation: Lekin yana urindi, grant yutdi va **oxiri** Londondagi universitetga **borib qoldi**.

sentences.text: There she **came up with** the idea of selling Khiva embroidery online.
sentences.translation: U yerda Xiva kashtachiligini onlayn sotish g'oyasini **o'ylab topdi**.

sentences.text: With two friends she **set up** a small company from her student room.
sentences.translation: Ikki do'sti bilan talabalar yotoqxonasidagi xonasidan kichik kompaniya **tashkil qildi**.

sentences.text: Women from her village now **make up** most of her team.
sentences.translation: Hozir uning jamoasining katta qismini qishlog'idagi ayollar **tashkil qiladi**.

sentences.text: Last year a journalist from the BBC **turned up** to interview her.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili undan intervyu olish uchun BBC jurnalisti **kelib qoldi**.

sentences.text: Today many girls in Khiva **look up to** Nilufar as a role model.
sentences.translation: Bugun Xivadagi ko'plab qizlar Nilufarni o'zlariga **o'rnak qilib olishgan**.
